left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adenocarcinoma of the prostate
  -  Performance Status < 2
  -  Clinical stages (not radiographic stage) T1c - T2a, Nx  [OR] or N0, Mx  [OR] or M0
  -  Gleason 6-7 cancer
  -  Prostate volume < 60 cc (if MRI  [AND] and TRUS have conflicting values, then MRI value will be utilized)
  -  International Prostate symptom score (IPSS) 20 or less
  -  Ability to undergo DCF-Pyl PSMA PET as part of pretreatment staging
  -  Signed study-specific consent form prior to registration
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Prior history of pelvic radiation therapy
  -  Major medical  [OR] or psychiatric illness which, in the investigator's opinion, would prevent completion of treatment  [AND] and would interfere with follow up

right.raw_text:
-  Implanted device  [OR] or apparatus which obstruct visibility of the implanted sources on fluoroscopy
  -  Metallic implants, [OR]  claustrophobia not amenable to medication, [OR]  or known contraindications to undergoing MR scanning
  -  History of other malignancy diagnosed within the past 3 years
